title: Sunday Service - Reservoir
notes: Weekly Sunday service at the Reservoir church at 10:00 AM. IMPORTANT: on Sunday 11 October there is no separate Reservoir service - both congregations meet together at Doncaster for the church council election, at a time not yet announced. Sometimes the two congregations meet together in one location instead of holding separate services. Those joint services are announced beforehand - if you are unsure for a particular Sunday, ask at church.

title: Sunday Service - Doncaster
notes: Weekly Sunday service at the Doncaster church at 1:30 PM. Sometimes the two congregations meet together in one location instead of holding separate services. Those joint services are announced beforehand - if you are unsure for a particular Sunday, ask at church.

title: School Holiday Program
notes: School holiday activities. Please arrange with Elham (الهام) and Raha (رها).

title: Guest Preacher: Revd Dr Mark Duire
notes: Revd Dr Mark Duire will preach at both the Doncaster and Reservoir services.

title: English Classes - New Term (Doncaster)
notes: New term begins Thursday 8 October and runs weekly on Thursday evenings. Runs each week with no end date set yet. Register with Farzaneh (فرزانه).

title: English Classes - New Term (Reservoir)
notes: New term begins Friday 9 October and runs weekly on Friday mornings. Runs each week with no end date set yet. Register with Farzaneh (فرزانه).

title: Church Council Election - Joint Service
location: Doncaster church (joint service for both congregations)
notes: Voting for the new church council. Collect your voting form from Farzaneh (فرزانه). Completed forms must be handed in by Sunday 4 October at the latest. The TIME of this joint service has NOT been announced - do NOT state a time for it, and do not assume it keeps either congregation's usual hour. Tell people to check at church.

title: Confirmation by the Bishop
notes: Confirmation service led by the Bishop. Anyone wishing to be confirmed should collect the relevant form from Farzaneh (فرزانه) beforehand.

title: First Step and Discipleship Classes - starting in October, exact date NOT yet announced
notes: New First Step and Discipleship classes begin sometime in October. The exact starting date has NOT been announced yet - do not state a specific date. Runs each week with no end date set yet. Register with Farzaneh (فرزانه), who will confirm when they start.
